requirement: Build an agent that starts from a plain prompt and ends with a signed document. MCP server wraps Foxit PDF Services API (40 tools for doc gen, conversion, merging, compression, OCR, extraction). Signing is NOT in catalog — agent must call Foxit eSign API directly with own credentials, person signs. Handoff is the challenge.

rubric.criterion: Tool coverage (40 Foxit PDF Services tools used reversibly)
Signing handoff design (agent calls eSign API directly, person signs, boundary defended)
Workflow defensibility (argue where signing belongs, boundary choice)

rubric.check: README has demo video link + repo public

must_have: Call Foxit PDF Services API for doc work
Call Foxit eSign API separately (not via MCP)
